title: Older work finishes moving sooner
summary: Work your AIs left waiting the old way now moves into its new home in far fewer steps.

payload.title: Older work moves over sooner
payload.body: Trillion is moving the work your AIs left waiting into the new way it keeps things. Each step used to look over thousands of old items to pick up a few dozen. Now it stops as soon as it has them, so the move finishes sooner and your account answers faster while it runs.
